quotes.quote: The modern organization operates most effectively by orienting itself around highly empowered teams who broaden their capabilities to absorb cross-team and cross-functional handoffs, can rely on automated harnesses to address most remaining cross-functional approvals, and accelerate high-quality decision making through rapid prototyping. The premise here is an old one, but AI-tooling has shifted what’s possible in remarkable ways.
quotes.title: Roadmap decisions rather than dates.

quotes.quote: In short, we will transition from an era of *proof scarcity* to an era of *proof abundance*. Most of our institutions — journals, priority conventions, hiring and promotion criteria, prizes, the very notion of a research program — were designed under the assumption of scarcity, and it should not surprise us if they behave poorly under abundance.
quotes.note: From scarcity → abundance. Feels like we'll see the same thing for more than proofs, but code and all knowledge work... good analogy.
quotes.title: Mathematics in the age of AI
